long_description:
VideoGen makes it easy for anyone to create professional, copyright-free videos in seconds. Our AI video generator turns a prompt, script, or article into a finished video, complete with AI voiceover, subtitles, and b-roll, powered by the latest models like Sora, Veo, and Kling. Today, over 5 million users trust VideoGen, from individuals and small businesses to teams at Google and ByteDance.

Making videos is hard, time-consuming, and expensive if you hire someone to do it for you. With VideoGen, it only takes a few clicks! Try it at https://videogen.io/, or build video into your own product with our API: https://videogen.io/videogen-api
name: VideoGen
one_liner: Create professional videos in minutes with AI, online or via API
